identity.name: Shankhapushpi
identity.botanical_name: Convolvulus prostratus Forssk. (syn. Convolvulus pluricaulis Choisy)

identification.description: Small prostrate or spreading herb with slender hairy stems, narrow leaves and solitary funnel-shaped white to pale flowers. Ayurvedic Shankhapushpi has historically variable botanical identification; the NCISM-associated Convolvulus identification is retained with the synonym noted.

shlokas:
शङ्खपुष्पी तु शङ्खाह्वा माङ्गल्यकुसुमापि च ।
शङ्खपुष्पी सरा मेध्या वृष्या मानसरोगहृत् ।
रसायनी कषायोष्णा स्मृतिकान्तिबलाग्निदा ।
दोषापस्मारभूताश्रीकुष्ठकृमिविषप्रणुत् ॥२२८॥
nighantu_references: Bhavaprakasha Nighantu, Guduchyadi Varga, verse 228 in the searchable recension.

metadata.note: Classical plant identity is historically variable; do not present Convolvulus as an uncontested botanical identification.
